### Good News for Jacob
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/good-news-jacob
Passage: Genesis 45:28
Points:
- Joseph's elevation in Egypt reveals God's sovereign providence working to preserve His covenant people.
- Moving to Egypt protected Jacob's household from cultural assimilation in Canaan and prepared them for the exodus.
- Jacob had languished in grief for decades, but knowing Joseph lived revived his spirit and renewed his purpose.
- Unlike Jacob, modern believers possess the complete Word of God to discern His will and interpret life's circumstances.

### How Does Coming to Jesus Lead to Going?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-12-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 45:26-27
Points:
- Joseph did not merely forgive and restore his brothers; he commissioned them with a vital message.
- The brothers returned home as heralds proclaiming that Joseph was alive, exalted, and ruling.
- Jacob's spirit was revived when he heard their testimony and saw the provision sent to bring him home.
- Christians who receive Christ's forgiveness are called to go out and proclaim His resurrection, majesty, and grace.
